title: Stoker’s Mint Can 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco
description:
Stoker’s Mint Can 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco

Stoker’s Mint Can 12oz Long Cut Chewing Tobacco is a chewing tobacco product base on long cut tobacco. The fact that the tobacco is long makes it easier pack and pinch, while staying together better in your mouth. Stoker’s Mint Can 12oz Tobacco is manufacture by National Tobacco Company and has a smooth tobacco flavor, with hints mint. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compare to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experience in plug and loose leaf. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Stoker’s brand page.
